credits.title: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
credits.overview: Bamakhyapa, an Indian saint living in the 18th century, is a great devotee of Goddess Tara. Though he is against the unconventional orthodox temple practices, he uses his divine powers to help the needy.

credits.title: Haati Haati Paa Paa
credits.overview: A daughter balances caring for her aging father with her own life, revealing generational bonds and family tensions in contemporary society.

credits.title: Manohar & I
credits.overview: Two solitary individuals meet each other every day in the city of Calcutta and share the stories of their imaginary life. But one day when death makes an appearance, the truth is revealed.
